name: A slow betrayal
about: Another house courts a bannerman who holds a grudge, with letter after letter and cask after cask of gold. His liege grows suspicious. In the end the town changes hands, or its lord loses his head.
title: The Treason of {town}
fade: The letters stop coming to {town}. Whatever {turncoat} meant to do, {turncoat.he} never does it.

beats.speaker: turncoat
beats.text: A man posing as a merchant comes to {town} with letters from {tempter} of {tempter.house}, and leaves without them.

memory.turncoat: {tempter} wrote to me as an equal. My own liege never has.

beats.speaker: turncoat
beats.text: {tempter.house} sends gold to {town} hidden in wine casks. {turncoat} buys horses and says they're for the tourney.

memory.turncoat: I took {tempter}'s gold. There is no unknowing it.

beats.speaker: liege
beats.text: {liege} hears about the horses and the casks, and invites {turncoat} to spend the winter at {liege.seat}. {turncoat} claims to have a fever.

memory.liege: {turncoat} will not come to {liege.seat}. A loyal man comes when called.
memory.turncoat: {liege} called me to {liege.seat} for the winter. I said I had a fever. I do not.

beats.speaker: turncoat
beats.text: {turncoat} finally rides to {liege.seat}, between two lines of {liege.house}'s spearmen.

beats.speaker: liege
beats.text: The letters from {tempter} are read aloud, and then {liege} has {turncoat} beheaded in the yard at {liege.seat}.

memory.liege: {tempter} bought my bannerman {turncoat} with gold. I took the traitor's head and I will have more.

die.how: I was beheaded at {liege.seat} for taking {tempter}'s gold.

liege.text: make {tempter} pay for buying my bannerman

beats.speaker: liege
beats.text: {liege} forgives {turncoat} in front of the hall, but keeps {turncoat}'s eldest at {liege.seat} as a ward. Everyone knows why.

memory.turncoat: {liege} forgave me and took my child as surety. I will be watched until I die.

beats.speaker: turncoat
beats.text: On a moonless night {turncoat} opens the gates of {town} to {tempter.house}. By dawn there are new banners on the walls.

memory.tempter: {turncoat} gave me {town} for the price of a few casks.
memory.turncoat: I opened the gates of {town} to {tempter.house}. I have betrayed {liege}, and I would do it again.

beats.speaker: liege
beats.text: {liege} won't stand for it. The army of {liege.house} marches on {town} to take it back from {tempter}.

beats.speaker: liege
beats.text: {town} is {liege.house}'s again. {turncoat} is found hiding in the bell tower.

die.how: They found me in the bell tower of {town}.

beats.speaker: turncoat
beats.text: {turncoat} sits safe in {town} under {tempter.house}'s banners. Bannermen across the realm see that treason pays.

beats.speaker: turncoat
beats.text: {turncoat} burns {tempter}'s letters without reading them, and sends the ashes to {liege} in a box.

memory.liege: {turncoat} sent me the ashes of {tempter}'s letters. A loyal man.
memory.tempter: {turncoat} burned my letters and sent the ashes to {liege}. Spurned like a peddler.

beats.text: {tempter} dies, and the gold stops coming to {town}. {turncoat} never mentions the letters, and one night burns them in the kitchen fire.
